judge.rationale: The candidate never actually implemented the production fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, leaving `beforeSession` outside the `try` block. Because of this omission, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` will fail when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the candidate completely missed the required update to `CHANGELOG.md`. While the spec update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` closely matches the reference, the candidate put the new test in a separate file rather than `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and left a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff.
